item.name: Uppercut Dash
item.howToPerform: To perform the "Uppercut Dash" Technique you need to forward dash right after a mini uppercut, then loop back directly below them as soon as possible to hit the target with a front dash.
item.cardSummary: Forward dash in a loop right after a mini uppercut so the target rolls into empty air and takes almost no knockback, leaving a side dash extension open.

item.name: Upside Down Ragdoll
item.howToPerform: To perform the Upside Down Ragdoll tech you need to downslam someone IMMEDIATELY when they get up.
item.cardSummary: Downslam someone the instant they rise from ragdoll and their torso over-rotates onto their head, with a hitbox that lets ground moves connect.

item.name: Uppercut Jump
item.howToPerform: To perform this, do 3 m1s, jump, then immediately uppercut.
item.cardSummary: Three M1s, jump, then an instant uppercut opens a window to use grounded-only moves in midair or change how a move lands.

item.name: Uppercut Flick
item.howToPerform: First, mini uppercut your target and immediately forward dash in a loop to hit the forward dash as the player falls down.
item.cardSummary: The easy version of Uppercut Dash: mini uppercut, then loop a forward dash to clip the target as they float.

item.name: Stun Negation
item.cardSummary: A forward dash timed to the exact frame someone rises from ragdoll, punching through their usual no-stun window.

item.name: Delayed M1s
item.cardSummary: Deliberately slowing your M1 string to buy cooldown time mid-combo, trading rhythm for a refreshed dash or move.

item.name: M1 Shove
item.cardSummary: An M1 timed to shove the opponent for repositioning or a sliver of extra damage.

item.name: Backdash Cancel
item.cardSummary: Fire a move mid-backdash to cancel it into a surprise attack.

item.name: Aerial Backdash Cancel
item.cardSummary: The airborne version of the backdash cancel, stretching its range with a jump.

item.name: Wall Extend
item.cardSummary: A wall-assisted inescapable combo loop whose strength depends on the character used.

item.name: Ground Punch
item.howToPerform: You must ragdoll the opponent, then wait a bit before performing an M1 string. If done correctly, you will knock the opponents away on the final M1.
item.cardSummary: Ragdoll the opponent, wait a beat, then start an M1 string as they rise to knock them straight back down.

item.name: DMG Chip
item.cardSummary: A mini uppercut woven into dashes that stuns players while they are still mid-ragdoll.

item.name: Micro Dash
item.howToPerform: Side dash, and immediately use a move. Punching does not work because it will not cancel the dash.
item.cardSummary: Side dash and immediately use a move: the dash cuts short, moving you a sliver of the distance at full speed.

item.name: Headwalk
item.cardSummary: After a mini uppercut, walk onto the opponent's head to keep the combo running from above.

item.name: True Downslam
item.cardSummary: Downslam off the third M1's stun so the opponent cannot ragdoll cancel out of it.

item.name: Trashy Escape Plan
item.cardSummary: A movement meme: jump and side dash at a trashcan sideways with shiftlock off to get launched.

item.name: Bench-Jump
item.cardSummary: Climb a bench's backrest and jump for extra height, the game's most law-abiding movement tech.

item.name: Ragdoll Shove
item.howToPerform: To perform the Ragdoll Shove Tech, you need to do: 3m1 + shove + m1 right after.
item.cardSummary: Three M1s, shove, then an instant M1: the ragdolled opponent eats fall damage on the way down.

item.name: Double Downslam
item.cardSummary: Downslam, punch string, then a second downslam before the opponent recovers.

item.name: Tactical Yeet
item.cardSummary: Uppercut into a roll applied on an already-rolling opponent, launching them absurd distances.

item.name: Kick
item.howToPerform: You need to side dash to your opponent and do shove quickly after the 4th m1
item.cardSummary: A shove buried right after the fourth M1: a damage-free Ragdoll Shove used purely for style points.

item.name: Makaku
item.howToPerform: After the move shove, you need to immediately M1. Keep in mind that this only works after 0, 1, or 2 M1s into shove, otherwise you will just do the ragdoll shove tech. Also if you use Consecutive Punches right before Sho
item.cardSummary: Shove then instant M1 (only after 0 to 2 M1s), keeping the opponent standing for a fresh string.

item.name: Shove Dash
item.howToPerform: After using the move shove, m1 right away. After that, back away for a bit, then forward dash. {{WdsTooltips |toggle = {} |content = Make sure the M1 you use after the shove is the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd M1. Otherwise, it'll j
item.cardSummary: Shove, instant M1, step back, then forward dash: a bait-and-punish rhythm tech.

item.name: Ragdoll Shove Dash
item.howToPerform: To perform the ragdoll shove Dash, you need to: 3m1 + shove + m1 right after + Instant forward dash
item.cardSummary: A Ragdoll Shove finished with an instant forward dash so the knockback carries the fall damage further.

item.name: Uppercut Strike
item.cardSummary: An input timing that makes your follow-up hit land far faster after the Uppercut move.

item.name: Double Shove Downslam
item.cardSummary: Chains the Ragdoll Shove into the Double Downslam for one extended beating.

item.name: Shove Uppercut
item.cardSummary: A shove placement that buys one extra M1 and a second combo extender in the same string.

item.name: Headwalk Uppercut
item.cardSummary: A flair-only uppercut off a headwalk that launches the opponent further than normal.

item.name: Uppercut Shove Tech
item.cardSummary: An M1 reset built around Uppercut plus shove for extra damage.

item.name: Shove Upper Extender
item.howToPerform: Make sure to be close to the opponent and do 3m1s. Do a shove afterwards, while holding jump to mini uppercut them. As soon as the opponent goes in the air, loop dash towards them. Side dash once they fall to make the co
item.cardSummary: Three M1s, shove, then a held-jump mini uppercut: an Uppercut Dash with a shove's damage baked in.

item.name: Twisted Dash
item.howToPerform: To perform the twisted dash, you need to land the forward dash ASAP. Sometimes (almost always) you need to go backward a little bit before dashing
item.cardSummary: A forward dash the frame the fourth M1 lands, cutting the opponent's knockback so the combo continues.

item.name: Surf Tech
item.howToPerform: Perform 3 M1s turn around while doing Hunter's Grasp and hold the W key.
item.cardSummary: Three M1s, turn around mid Hunter's Grasp, and hold forward: the grasp carries you surfing along with the target.

item.name: Lethal Dash Extender
item.howToPerform: Right after using Lethal Whirlwind Stream, forward dash in a circle to hit your forward dash as EARLY AS POSSIBLE, when you land your dash, they should take less knockback and be within side dash reach to combo extend.
item.cardSummary: Loop a forward dash immediately after Lethal Whirlwind Stream to catch the target before they escape.

item.name: Whirlwind flick-dash
item.cardSummary: The flick-input version of the Whirlwind dash: same extension, simpler motion.

item.name: Kyoto
item.howToPerform: To perform the Kyoto tech, you need to side dash or backdash cancel ASAP after flowing water to catch them with Lethal Whirlwind Stream.
item.cardSummary: Side dash the instant Flowing Water ends to sweep the target into Lethal Whirlwind Stream.

item.name: Reverse Kyoto
item.cardSummary: Land Lethal Whirlwind on an airborne ragdolled target to reverse the Kyoto sequence.

item.name: Skyoto
item.cardSummary: An easier aerial entry into Kyoto that works even on descending targets.

item.name: Countering a Counter
item.howToPerform: Simply backdash during the small window before you get ragdolled by Prey's Peril to dodge and counter their counter (has to be the last hit to be inescapable with Prey's Peril). Note that you can also use unblockable mov
item.cardSummary: Backdash during the tiny window before Prey's Peril ragdolls you to dodge the counter and punish it.

item.name: Uppercut Grasp
item.howToPerform: To perform this tech you need to do 3 M1s + jump + mini uppercut + hunter's grasp.
item.cardSummary: Three M1s, jump, mini uppercut, then Hunter's Grasp: the fastest reliable grasp confirm.

item.name: Grasp Punch
item.cardSummary: A punch timed to freeze an opponent's knockback mid-flight from Hunter's Grasp.

item.name: Webby Smash
item.cardSummary: Bounce Lethal Whirlwind Stream off a fence or wall to throw the target at an unexpected angle.

item.name: Curve Dash
item.cardSummary: Four M1s, side dash behind the falling opponent, then an ability from the blind side.

item.name: Peril Twist
item.cardSummary: Turn around during Prey's Peril's final punch so the knockback lands where your combo continues.

item.name: Flowing Dash
item.howToPerform: After the final hit of flowing water front dash ASAP in a zigzag.
item.cardSummary: Zigzag a forward dash the moment Flowing Water ends to keep the M1 string alive.

item.name: Samdak Grasp
item.cardSummary: A timing that fits Hunter's Grasp in after a string it normally cannot follow.

item.name: Hamster Wheel
item.cardSummary: A ping-dependent Kyoto shortcut that only really lands on high-latency opponents.

item.name: Water Stream True Extender
item.cardSummary: A true extender off Water Stream Cutting Fist that opens guaranteed follow-up combos.

item.name: Swirl Tech
item.cardSummary: Kyoto in reverse: Lethal Whirlwind first, then Flowing Water as they drop.

item.name: Monster brr brr patapim
item.cardSummary: A Monster Form sequence tech named after the meme, chaining form moves into a loop.

item.name: Whirl Dive
item.cardSummary: Doom Dive canceled straight into Crimson Whirl with no recovery gap.

item.name: Crowd Buster M1 Reset
item.cardSummary: A Monster Form M1 reset discovered off Crowd Buster's recovery.

item.name: Lore Tech / Lore Combo
item.cardSummary: Monster Form's parallel to the Lethal Whirlwind extension, run through its own kit.

item.name: Regressor Tech / Binding Cloth M1 Reset
item.cardSummary: Binding Cloth into a small loop dash for an instant M1 reset.

item.name: Instant Binding Tech
item.cardSummary: An instant M1 extension straight out of Binding Cloth.

item.name: Doom Hammer Heel Technique
item.cardSummary: A Monster Form link from Hammer Heel into a continued combo.

item.name: Wrathful Beatdown
item.cardSummary: An extended Monster Form beatdown string built from its core moves.

item.name: Crimson Wheel Launcher
item.howToPerform: Right when you land hammer heel aim at a 45+ degree angle (Your choice as long as it doesn't reduce the damage) and when you're about to throw the opponent quickly look straight backwards, hold M1 side dash and downslam.
item.cardSummary: Hammer Heel aimed 45 degrees upward converts into a launcher without losing damage.

item.name: Weaving Cloth Combo
item.howToPerform: Start the combo by doing an uppercut followed by a jump and Binding Cloth. While you are using Binding Cloth, hold down the jump button and use the aerial variant of Hammer Heel. *see here if they use evasive* After the
item.cardSummary: Uppercut, jump, Binding Cloth, then weave M1s while the cloth holds them.

item.name: Binding Dive
item.howToPerform: After hitting the first dive of Doom Dive (2nd press), align your position so that the 3rd press will land short of your opponent but will still cause them to roll. Before the third press of Doom Dive (1), use Binding Cl
item.cardSummary: Position Doom Dive's third hit short of the target so the landing combos instead of scattering.

item.name: Crimson Whirl Is Overrated
item.howToPerform: Instead of using Hammer Heel while facing towards the opponent, look to the left around 70 to 90 degrees. Side dash and run towards your opponent shortly before performing a forward dash. If the opponent is on the ground
item.cardSummary: Face 70 to 90 degrees off-target during Hammer Wheel so the forward dash connects cleanly after.

item.name: Ignition Dash
item.cardSummary: Turn around mid Ignition Burst so both its startup and finisher hits land on the same target.

item.name: 26.5% Ignition M1 Reset
item.cardSummary: An Ignition Dash adjusted into a full M1 reset at a stated 26.5 percent success rate.

item.name: Coward Catcher
item.howToPerform: Very simple, just hold m1 while doing Ignition Burst like the 's Shove Dash tech.
item.cardSummary: Hold M1 through Ignition Burst to snag opponents who run from the wind-up; strictly situational.

item.name: Explosive Shot Blitz
item.cardSummary: An M1 extension threaded off Blitz Shot's knockback.

item.name: Air Burst
item.cardSummary: An Ignition Dash with a mini uppercut mixed in, catching targets at air height.

item.name: Air Burst Extend
item.cardSummary: The Air Burst variant that skips the finisher hit so the M1 string keeps going.

item.name: Ignition Blitz
item.cardSummary: Blitz Shot into Ignition Burst as a two-move extension.

item.name: Ignition Burst Wall Boost
item.cardSummary: Complex movement that rides Ignition Burst up walls for absurd vertical distance.

item.name: Wall Combo Bug
item.howToPerform: You need to spam the 4 move after the fourth m1, and once the startup plays, forward dash.
item.cardSummary: A glitch: spam the fourth move after your fourth M1 and forward dash on its startup to wall-combo mid-skill.

item.name: Heavens Rhythm
item.howToPerform: To perform Heavens Rhythm, use Ignition Burst on a ragdolled/blocking player, and quickly use a shortened Blitz Shot (hold for a short period instead of a simple tap). This will ragdoll the player out of the roll which c
item.cardSummary: Ignition Burst on a ragdolled or blocking player, followed instantly, to keep them locked in the rhythm.

item.name: Uppercut Flick 2: The Sequel
item.howToPerform: To perform Uppercut Flick 2: The Sequel (or UF2 for short), the player must angle their camera in such a way that when they dash, they can press shiftlock to reangle their dash straight under their opponent. You have to
item.cardSummary: An angled-camera version of the Uppercut Flick built for this kit's dashes.

item.name: Fourfold Rebound
item.cardSummary: Dash timing off Fourfold Flashstrike that reopens the M1 string.

item.name: The Flash Strike Tech
item.howToPerform: Make your opponent go in a rolling state, then jump, use Flash Strike and side dash to catch your opponent.
item.cardSummary: Force a roll, jump, Flash Strike, then side dash to meet the target on the other side.

item.name: Explosive Flash Strike
item.howToPerform: Start with 4 M1s then use explosive shuriken ASAP as soon as you knock them away with the fourth M1, this will fling them up and back in a rolling state, then time your Flash Strike to them at the perfect range to combo
item.cardSummary: Four M1s into an instant Explosive Shuriken, then Flash Strike to chase the knockback.

item.name: Shuri Scatter
item.howToPerform: Preform 3 M1 into a mini uppercut. Once they opponent is around body level use Explosive Shuriken, and then immediately use Scatter. This will catch them mid-air in your Scatter, or depending on your timing will catch th
item.cardSummary: Three M1s, mini uppercut, then Explosive Shuriken at body height with Scatter as the follow-up.

item.name: ALL UR HP R BELONG TO ME
item.howToPerform: You need to use 4 m1s while moving forward. then once you close around 10-15% of the gap (estimate, not accurate) by walking forward, jump and use explosive shuriken. if done correctly, the shuriken should land behind th
item.cardSummary: Four advancing M1s into a gap-close that claims most of the health bar when the spacing lands.

item.name: Flash Dunk
item.howToPerform: First, cause rolling via either an m1 shove or a front dash close to the target. As soon as possible, jump and use Flash Strike. This will sometimes cause the target to get slight knockback, and other times will result i
item.cardSummary: Cause a roll, then dunk them out of the air with a timed follow-up before the roll ends.

item.name: Explosive Elevation Roll
item.howToPerform: First, knock down the opponent by any means, and force them into the ragdoll state. Then, as long as they are any amount higher than you, throw a normal variant shuriken at their body. It should launch them up, and allow
item.cardSummary: Knock the opponent into ragdoll below you and the elevation difference converts into a rolling state you can chase.

item.name: Shuriken Fling Grab
item.cardSummary: An air-variant shuriken caught into a grab for the extension.

item.name: Whirlwind Slam
item.cardSummary: An Upside Down Ragdoll cousin executed through this kit's slam.

item.name: Super Cool Tech to Amaze Your Friends However it's Pretty...
item.cardSummary: An air-shuriken experiment that became a legitimate extension, name and all.

item.name: Coward catcher Deadly Ninja variant
item.cardSummary: The kit's Coward Catcher variant for punishing runners.

item.name: Homerun Loop
item.cardSummary: An M1 extension after a non-airborne Homerun.

item.name: Versatile Slam
item.cardSummary: Grand Slam spaced so its landing hit meets the target exactly as they recover.

item.name: Foul Ball Rebound
item.cardSummary: Foul Ball's rock used as a knockback tool that tees up either extension route.

item.name: Foul Homerun
item.cardSummary: An input that makes Foul Ball into Homerun a guaranteed true link.

item.name: Batter's Pitch
item.cardSummary: Angling Foul Ball upward rides gravity to throw the rock much further than normal.

item.name: Foul Spinback
item.cardSummary: A release timing that widens Foul Ball's effective rock hitbox.

item.name: Chicken Jockey
item.cardSummary: Ragdoll via four M1s, then mount for the ride-along beatdown the name promises.

item.name: Inescapable Grab
item.cardSummary: A grab setup that lands guaranteed damage even through the Evasive ability.

item.name: Stay Down
item.cardSummary: Uses the kit's final M1 as a downslam substitute, minus the escape window a real downslam grants.

item.name: Foul Play
item.cardSummary: A Foul Ball follow-up window that converts the rock hit into pressure.

item.name: Unstoppable Homerun
item.cardSummary: A Homerun timing variant for keeping the bat pressure unbroken.

item.name: World WACKIEST Wall Extend!
item.cardSummary: Grand Slam into an instant dash at a wall for a wall-combo extension.

item.name: Foul Extend
item.cardSummary: Foul Ball, instant side dash, then Beatdown before the target settles.

item.name: Homerun Extend
item.cardSummary: Homerun, side dash, then Grand Slam to keep swinging.

item.name: Slow-Mo Foul
item.cardSummary: Hold the third M1 into a no-leap Foul Ball for a slow-motion true link.

item.name: Precision Cut
item.cardSummary: A Pinpoint Cut placement that turns the combo inescapable.

item.name: Back to Back
item.cardSummary: Quick Slice woven back-to-back with M1s for the damage stack.

item.name: freshfrenchfries Tech
item.cardSummary: Aerial Pinpoint Cut landed even on ragdolled targets for the extension.

item.name: Phantom Cleave
item.cardSummary: Answer an enemy Ultimate with an instant Atmos Cleave punish.

item.name: True Fire Slam
item.cardSummary: Fire slam threaded inside an M1 string rather than after it.

item.name: Double Fireslam
item.cardSummary: Triggers the downslam passive twice in one sequence for maximum damage.

item.name: pinpoint cut tech so cool
item.cardSummary: Pinpoint Cut into a walk-up, the kit's version of the uppercut extender.

item.name: Kusho Dodge
item.cardSummary: A movement pattern that dodges Atomic Slash entirely without spending ragdoll cancel.

item.name: Green
item.cardSummary: A perfected setup known simply as Green: the kit's signature true extension.

item.name: Windstorm Dash
item.cardSummary: One M1 and a forward dash off Windstorm Fury reopens the string.

item.name: Wind Sage Extender
item.cardSummary: Two M1 extends squeezed from a single Wind Sage usage.

item.name: Meteoric Smash
item.cardSummary: Cosmic Strike into Terrible Tornado arranged into an inescapable sequence.

item.name: Expulsive Catch
item.cardSummary: A Windstorm catch popularized by the YouTuber Loppy, converting the pull into a held combo.

item.name: Tornado Flow
item.cardSummary: Windstorm Fury into an easy M1 reset flow.

item.name: Skibidi Coffin
item.cardSummary: An M1 shove setup that makes Stone Coffin a true extension.

item.name: bonk
item.cardSummary: Psychic Ricochet comboed straight out of a landed Cosmic Strike.

item.name: Get back here
item.cardSummary: The recovery net for a failed Uppercut Dash: a pull that drags the escapee back in.

item.name: Triple Slam
item.cardSummary: Three consecutive slams chained for the extra damage.

item.name: Airborne Grab
item.cardSummary: Three M1s, uppercut, headwalk, then Crushing Pull from above.

item.name: Head First M1 Reset
item.howToPerform: this: Use Head First, face yourself, spam Front Dash, and the moment you front dash, enable shift-lock to turn around and hit the enemy. An easier variant is to do a downslam after and loop dash, but that cannot be reset
item.cardSummary: Head First converted into an M1 reset through a shiftlock-timed front dash.

item.name: Whirlwind Kick
item.howToPerform: this: Hold M1 whilst using Vanishing Kick, and when your M1 connects, use Whirlwind Drop. Wait and use Vanishing Kick again.
item.cardSummary: Hold M1 through Vanishing Kick and Whirlwind Drop becomes safe on hit.

item.name: Whirlwind Stop
item.howToPerform: this: Jump and M1 whilst going onto the enemy's head, using Whirlwind Drop immediately. Same methodology as the Hunter's Grasp uppercut. Once performed, do a front dash or another move as a surprise.
item.cardSummary: A headwalk Whirlwind Drop that trades the fling for an M1 reset or ambush.

item.name: Rockstar Reset
item.howToPerform: this: Use Bullet Barrage, and right as they begin rolling your Head First must connect. Face the direction they began rolling and spam Front Dash. Do it correctly and you earned a free reset.
item.cardSummary: The iconic 1-4 combo rebuilt into a true M1 reset via a rolling Head First link.

item.name: Draconic Supa
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a dragon uppercut at a 45 degree angle to an opponent whilst walking into them. Shiftlock setting does not matter.
item.cardSummary: A 45-degree dragon uppercut while walking into the target flings you both, the Supa tech in draconic form.

item.name: Supa Splitting Strike
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a Draconic Supa and use Earth Splitting Strike at about 3/4 of the total height. Turn the camera around to move the shockwave to where the dragon is. Do it correctly and it will automatically hit.
item.cardSummary: Draconic Supa capped with Earth Splitting Strike at three quarters of the flight's height.

item.name: Draconic Fissure
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a dragon uppercut, Side Dash left, face left, and summon Grand Fissure right as the dragon thrashes left.
item.cardSummary: Dragon uppercut, side dash left, then Grand Fissure summoned to meet the falling target.

item.name: Fissure Fangs
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a Draconic Fissure. When the second plate falls, immediately use Twin Fangs. Use Earth Splitting Strike as backup. Doing it correctly should either kill or leave the opponent with 1 HP.
item.cardSummary: Draconic Fissure into an immediate Twin Fangs when the second plate drops: the kit's instant-kill line.

item.name: Draconic Barrage
item.howToPerform: this: Peform a dragon uppercut on the absolute left of the player, Side Dash left, and peform a Backdash-Cancelled Bullet Barrage facing the way the player will be flung.
item.cardSummary: Uppercut passive converted into a full Bullet Barrage from the left side.

item.name: Dragon Drop
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a dragon uppercut, Side Dash 10 degrees clockwise to the left, and use Whirlwind Drop when the dragon thrashes to the right. If done correctly, the opponent will be thrusted into the air. Follow up with any
item.cardSummary: The uppercut passive turned into an extender using Whirlwind, no Vanishing Kick needed.

item.name: Draconic Dropkick
item.howToPerform: this: Hit a Vanishing Kick and immediately do a Dragon Drop. Do the Vanishing Kick variant as they hit the floor.
item.cardSummary: Vanishing Kick into an immediate Dragon Drop for the extension.

item.name: Rocksupa
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a Draconic Supa and use Vanishing Kick a little later. Aim for the dragon and hold M1.
item.cardSummary: Draconic Supa with a slightly delayed Vanishing Kick aimed at the dragon: unstoppable when timed.

item.name: Draconic Kick
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a dragon uppercut, Side Dash left, and use Vanishing Kick when they get thrown. M1 and Front Dash to continue your combo.
item.cardSummary: Dragon uppercut, side dash left, Vanishing Kick as they come through: a ranked-match discovery.

item.name: Draconic Head First
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a dragon uppercut, Side Dash left, and Back Dash. Spam Head First and you should be able to connect it.
item.cardSummary: Dragon uppercut into spammed Head First off a back dash for the extension.

item.name: Draconic Uppercut Reset
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a dragon uppercut, Side Dash, walk forward, and then Front Dash when they hit the floor.
item.cardSummary: Dragon uppercut, side dash, walk forward, front dash on their landing: a clean M1 reset.

item.name: Whirlwind Headstand Reset
item.howToPerform: this: Perform 4 M1s and immediately use Whirlwind Drop. Adjust your position so they land on your head. Continue M1ing and use a Front Dash.
item.cardSummary: Four M1s into an instant Whirlwind Drop positioned so the target lands on their head, resetting M1s.

item.name: Vanishing Headstand Reset
item.howToPerform: this: Ragdoll your opponent and use Vanishing Kick's variant. Adjust your position so they land on your head. Continue M1ing and use a Front Dash.
item.cardSummary: Vanishing Kick's variant on a ragdolled target, positioned for the headstand landing and reset.

item.name: Vanishing Variant
item.howToPerform: this: Perform an M1 Shove and use the Vanishing Kick variant immediately. Side Dash and continue comboing for a true extender.
item.cardSummary: M1 Shove into the Vanishing Kick variant, side dash, and the string continues.

item.name: Vanishing Trip
item.howToPerform: this: Perform a delayed M1 Shove and use Vanishing Kick. This is counterable, so be careful.
item.cardSummary: A delayed M1 Shove into Vanishing Kick that forces ragdoll on the first hit; counterable, so pick moments.

item.name: Spiral Strike
item.cardSummary: An extension arranged so the opponent has no counter window at all.

item.name: Impact Toss
item.cardSummary: Bullet Barrage into a safely spaced Vanishing Kick.

item.name: Hurl Kick
item.cardSummary: A spacing tool: converts Vanishing Kick into a huge fling for distance or surprise.

item.name: Vanishing Dash
item.cardSummary: A Vanishing Kick timing that ragdolls unexpectedly mid-approach.

item.name: Bullet Barrage+
item.cardSummary: Vanishing Kick woven into Bullet Barrage for its maximum damage ceiling.

item.name: Blazing Fist
item.cardSummary: A deliberately disorienting Vanishing Kick extension that scrambles the opponent's read.

item.name: Breakage Slam
item.howToPerform: this: After ragdolling an opponent, wait a split second before wake up to use Grand Fissure. This will make it so that the moment of wake up causes your opponent to not get launched towards you any further allowing the b
item.cardSummary: Grand Fissure timed a split second before wake-up collects its bonus 25 percent damage.

item.name: Slam Lift
item.howToPerform: this: After using Vanishing Kick, quickly ragdoll your opponent, recast your Vanishing Kick then use Head First right after it lifts both of you midair. You can use Whirlwind Drop, cancel it midair with recast and then d
item.cardSummary: Vanishing Kick, ragdoll, recast: a flashy lift that confirms into Head First or M1s.

item.name: Fissure Loop
item.howToPerform: this: Use Grand Fissure, dash away from it, and turn around to hit the opponent back into the second impact.
item.cardSummary: Grand Fissure with a loop dash that knocks the opponent back into the plates for full damage.

item.name: Fissure Headstand
item.howToPerform: this: Peform an M1 whilst jumping on the opponent's head. Use Grand Fissure whilst on top of them. Follow up with any move.
item.cardSummary: Grand Fissure cast from the opponent's head so knockback never takes them out of it.

item.name: Combo Cancel
item.howToPerform: this: While doing a wall combo, you can side dash out of it. This is currently the only character in the game who is ale to do this. This technique allows you to cancel the wall combo and combo extend.
item.cardSummary: Side dashing out of a wall combo, the one clean exit the game allows.

item.name: Bullet Dash
item.howToPerform: this:After doing a Bullet Barrage, wait to fall down and wait for the moment when the target starts rolling, then M1 and forward dash in the direction they rolled in. You need to be very quick for this and keep the m1 as
item.cardSummary: Bullet Barrage, fall, then a forward dash timed to the target's recovery for the reset.

item.name: Shove Kick Dash

item.cardSummary: One or two M1s into a looped Vanishing Kick with an instant follow-up, this kit's Shove Dash.

item.name: M1 Shove Kick
item.cardSummary: The M1 Shove tech capped with an immediate Vanishing Kick.

item.name: Rip Off "Twisted
item.cardSummary: The kit's take on the Twisted extension, trading the dash timing for its own rhythm.

item.name: Mechanical Loopty Loop Spiral
item.cardSummary: A dash after Trinity Tear that reopens M1s, in the Lethal Dash family.

item.name: Weboom Extend V2
item.cardSummary: A downslam setup that makes Weboom a real extension.

item.name: Downslam Weboom Extend
item.cardSummary: A Weboom placed off a downslam to drain ragdoll cancel or stall for cooldowns.

item.name: Twinless
item.cardSummary: An angled Twin Burst that becomes an inescapable extender.

item.name: Explosive Push
item.cardSummary: Downslam while standing directly on top, then the explosive push carries the extension.

item.name: Rocket Missile
item.cardSummary: The Explosive Push setup angled away instead, sending them into the missile line.

item.name: Air Doom
item.cardSummary: The same downslam setup launched upward into the air variant.

item.name: Tactical DMG chip
item.cardSummary: Tactical Storm into a front dash loop, this kit's DMG chip.

item.name: Spider Snatch
item.cardSummary: Weboom placed behind you plus Trinity Tear drags the ragdolled target through it.

item.name: Trinity SLAM
item.cardSummary: Twin Burst angled like Twinless, then Trinity Tear slams the catch.

item.name: Dev’s Combo
item.cardSummary: The kit's ultimate-dependent showpiece combo, assembled from its ult toolkit.

item.name: Property In Egypt
item.howToPerform: Do 2 m1s and on third m1 jump and m1 at the same time, allowing you to get on top of your opponent without them being able to hit you because of the stun from the third m1. Next, aim your Swift Sweep similar to how Fdrfe
item.cardSummary: Two M1s, then jump-M1 on the third to mount their head for an inescapable extension.

item.name: Collateral Extend
item.cardSummary: Front dash after Collateral Ruin converts the roll into a continuation.

item.name: Sending Bro to China Be Like
item.howToPerform: Do 3 m1s and on 4th m1 side dash to the player positio and use "Swift Sweep" then land the dummy with forward Dash
item.cardSummary: Third M1, side dash on the fourth, Swift Sweep on landing: the meme-named ranged send-off.

item.name: Swift Turn
item.cardSummary: Turn around after Swift Sweep's first hit and the second hit extends instead of ending.

item.name: The Drizzliest Glizzy
item.cardSummary: A mini uppercut into an immediate Swift Sweep, the Swift Reprisal timing.

item.name: Catch This
item.cardSummary: Four M1s and a dash arranged Twisted-style for this kit.

item.name: Twisted
item.cardSummary: A pause after the fourth M1 opens the kit's version of the Twisted extension.

item.name: Grave Maker Loop
item.cardSummary: Grave Maker into a forward dash loop for the continuation.

item.name: Blast Breaker Extend
item.cardSummary: A two-version extension off Blast Breaker depending on your melee timing.

item.name: M1 Extend

item.cardSummary: The patched global exploit that once allowed up to seven M1s in a single string; removed, remembered.

item.name: Flash Strike
item.cardSummary: An early Deadly Ninja pairing of M1 Shove and Flash Strike, patched out.

item.name: Rebounding Robotics
item.cardSummary: Four M1s, side dash, and a catch that the balance pass eventually closed.

item.name: Troubling Catch
item.cardSummary: A dash extension off Double Trouble from before its patch.

item.name: Easy Weboom Extend
item.cardSummary: The original easy Weboom extension, patched into the harder modern setup.

item.name: Consecutive Blows
item.cardSummary: An extension that skipped Machine Gun Blows' final hit, closed by a later patch.
